Hi James / Anika — thanks for sending the documents and no worries about the earlier scramble. I reviewed the PDF and matrix with our legal team and summarized our position below (high-level):

- Section 4.2 (data retention): We can accept a 12-month retention for de-identified telemetry signals with a logging/attestation clause and mutual audit rights. We'll propose explicit language for the clause (see attached draft excerpt).
- Section 9 (indemnities): Redwood cannot accept unlimited regulatory carve-outs. We're prepared to narrow the regulatory indemnity to breaches caused by Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct and propose a capped remedy consistent with enterprise norms.
- SOW/milestone invoicing: We can support milestone-adjusted invoicing but will need payment schedule language aligned to delivery acceptance criteria (we've annotated the SOW matrix).

Proposed next steps: 1) I'll upload a short redline of the contract with our suggested edits and a one-page summary by EOD PT today; 2) Let's meet Tue 13 Jul at 2:00pm PT for a focused 30-minute session to walk the remaining items and agree on a path to signatures. If 2pm doesn't work, Evelyn / Marissa — please propose alternatives.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
